# Niveza India Pvt Ltd. (Niveza India Pvt. Ltd.)

Niveza India Pvt Ltd. is a Capital Markets company. Niveza is a financial companion. Niveza India Pvt Ltd. employs 25 people, founded in 2010. Headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across India and United States.

## About

Niveza India Pvt. Ltd. is a SEBI registered research, advisory, and financial technology firm. We have proven experience in providing one of the best performing stock picks backed by best-in-industry service and by money back guarantee. We are one of the best Advisory firm in India which works on the principles of Rakesh Jhunjhunwala and Warren Buffet Portfolio.'​

Our Executive Management
![praveen kedar](images/About%20us/praveen_kedar.png)
Praveen Kedar
CEO/Chief Investment Officer
Praveen has 25+ years experience in technology and management with last 20+ in United States. He became interested in equity markets 15 years ago and soon realized a huge challenge in finding a reliable equity adviser especially only in generating high brokerage at the expense of clients. Intra-day, F&O products are promoted as sure shot way to succeed in the market which results in most of the clients losing capital and existing markets in a short period of time. Rest of the market is flooded with small time stock tips providers who make impossible and unproven claims.
Praveen is on a mission to create the most trusted capital research and wealth management firm in India. He goes above and beyond to ensure that Niveza offers only those products which would create sustainable wealth for our clients.
![sayali kedar](images/About%20us/sayali_kedar.png)
Sayali Belgaonkar
COO/Director
Sayali has 12+ years of experience in business & technology management. She handles overall operations in India since last 7+ years with focus on sales strategy and technological development.
